answer: A robust sybil defense relies on an anchor of verifiable cost: every identity must wear a unique plume of stake and pass the epoch challenge to count in any tally. The network rejects cheap inflation by demanding real generation expense, just like a sable coat traded at true market value rather than printed freely. Ten thousand forged nodes still weigh only one valid identity in a tally, making mass sybil attacks economically self-defeating and structurally impossible.
